timeline.text: One tap used to both approve a LinkedIn job and open its whole application form -- before anyone looked at it.
Meanwhile safer jobs on NAV and FINN sat waiting on that same manual gate.
I split the trust: LinkedIn now always needs a human look first, no shortcut.
NAV and FINN get their auto-queue back once a score clears the bar, confirmed right in Telegram.
Consent is scoped per job and per platform now, not one switch for everything.
